subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should timestamped config backups preserve or convert existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery points, or may the new cleanup policy prune them on first post-upgrade write?
rationale: Config backups may be a user's only rollback copy, and repository policy treats config recovery and migration behavior as compatibility-sensitive rather than an automation-only cleanup choice.

options.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
options.body: Require this PR or a replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the bounded timestamped retention set before cleanup.

options.title: Accept First-Run Pruning
options.body: Allow a timestamp-only scheme to delete existing numbered backups on first write, accepting the upgrade recovery loss explicitly.

options.title: Keep The Numeric Ring
options.body: Reject the timestamped naming change for now and keep the documented numbered backup ring as the stable contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
recommendation.body: Require this PR or a replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the bounded timestamped retention set before cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent config backup/recovery history and is the likely owner for the migration contract decision.
